name: DexArcFi Risk Agent
description: A risk and yield assistant for DeFi users on Arc. It estimates liquidation distance and flags dangerous leverage (20x to 50x) before a perp trade, suggests safer position sizes and stop levels, and compares Earn, Vault and Staking yields for idle USDC. It only suggests: it never trades or moves funds. Estimates, not financial advice. Free tools are open to any caller; premium_analysis costs $0.01 USDC per request via x402 on Arc Testnet.
